reason: The first specimen needs to come home, and the flight locker is an obvious place to secure it.
expectation: I expect the membrane specimen to be placed in the flight locker, though it may need another step to secure it.

alternatives.reason: Harvesting lettuce seems like a natural way to take some of the garden along, but I want to stow the specimen first.

effect: Placing the membrane in the flight locker completed the specimen goal, so the garden is the remaining task.
reaction: It was straightforward and reassuring to see the specimen secured.
reason: Harvesting the new lettuce leaves is the only offered combination and seems like a way to bring some of the garden along.
expectation: I expect to cut fresh lettuce leaves that can be taken to the flight galley.

effect: The harvest produced departure lettuce leaves, ready to take to the flight galley.
reaction: The result was straightforward; I’m curious how the departure will unfold.
reason: The flight galley is the natural destination for the leaves, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the leaves to be stowed or prepared in the galley, completing the garden goal.

effect: The leaves became a flight meal, completing the garden goal and leading directly to liftoff with the core on cooling.
reaction: The meal box and the plain falling away made the departure feel satisfying, though I would have liked to see more of the ascent.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the lettuce into a flight meal gave the garden a personal place in the departure, and the view of the plain falling away made the ending feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward but produced no further detail on its own.

surprise.text: I expected the galley action to finish the garden goal, but it also led straight into liftoff.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the locker, scissors and galley all had clear purposes, though the choices were fairly predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, mainly to see what happens when the specimens reach Earth and how Mara responds.
